description:
Enhance the Metadata Primitives benchmark to stress-test metadata operations with
complex catalog scenarios that reflect real-world data warehouse characteristics.

The current implementation tests basic INFORMATION_SCHEMA queries against simple
schemas (TPC-H with 8 tables, ~60 columns total). Real production data warehouses
have significantly more complex metadata:

- Wide tables (100-1000+ columns) common in analytics/ML feature stores
- Nested view hierarchies (3-4+ levels) from BI tools like Looker, dbt, Tableau
- Complex data types (STRUCT, ARRAY, MAP, JSON) in modern data platforms
- Large catalogs (100s-1000s of tables) in multi-tenant environments
- Deep constraint/FK graphs in normalized operational databases

These complexity factors cause 5-100x slower metadata operations that are not
captured by the current benchmark. This enhancement adds a MetadataGenerator
component and new query categories to measure these performance characteristics.
